    if any(term in salary_str.lower() for term in non_numeric_terms):

    # 提取所有数字部分
    import re

    range_patterns = [
        r'(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[kKmM]?\s*[-–—]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[kKmM]?',  # 100-150 或 100k-150k
        r'\$?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[kKmM]?\s*to\s*\$?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[kKmM]?',  # 100 to 150 或 $100k to $150k
        r'(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*-\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)',  # 100 - 150
    ]
    
    for pattern in range_patterns:
        match = re.search(pattern, salary_str, re.IGNORECASE)
        if match:
            try:
                val1 = float(match.group(1))
                val2 = float(match.group(2))
                
                # 检查是否有k/M后缀
                if 'k' in salary_str.lower()[:match.start() + 20]:
                    val1 *= 1000
                    val2 *= 1000
                if 'm' in salary_str.lower()[:match.start() + 20]:

                    val2 *= 1000000

        r'\$?(\d+(?:,\d+)*(?:\.\d+)?)',  # $100,000, $100.50
    ]

        if match:
            try:
                val = float(match.group(1).replace(',', ''))
                
                # 检查k/M后缀

                    val *= 1000
                if 'm' in salary_str.lower():
                    val *= 1000000

            except:
                continue
